2. Material facts of the case, briefly are that the petitioners as pre-emptors brought the aforesaid case being Miscellaneous Case No. 43 of 2000 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act in the Coma of Assistant Judg, Nalitabari, Sherpur impleading the opposite parties for  in empting the case land as described in the schedule of the application on the allegation that the opposite party No. 2. Iman Ali without, serving any notice upon the pre-emptor transferred the case land to the pre-emptee-opposite party No. 1 by kabala deed No.1783 dated 9.3.1993. It is further contended that the opposite parties in collusion with each other in order to defeat the right of pre-emption registered the sale deed in the name of deed of exchange fine pre-emptors being co-sharers are entitled to pre-empt the disputed Kabala registered on 9.3.1993. 

 3. The opposite party No. 1 contested the suit by filing written statement contending inter-alia, that all the allegations are false and without any legal basis. The case is not maintainable in its present form inasmuch as the impugned deed is a deed of awaz. 

 11. On a close perusal of the evidence of PW-1, PW-2, P.W-3 and P.W-4 and other material on records, it appears that the pre-emptors namely, (1) Md. Afal Uddin and (2) Most. Jabeda Khatun wife of Afal uddih were not examined in this case. PW-1, Zoinal Abedin son of pre-emptor was examined in this case as PW-1, who in his deposition stated nothing as to why their father and mother (pre-emptors) were not examined in this case. This witness in his deposition stated nothing that the pre-emptee-purchaser is a stranger to the case land. PW-2, P.W-3 and PW-4 also in their respective deposition staled nothing that the pre-emptee-purchaser is a stranger to the case land. 

 12. Pre-emptee-opposite party No. 1, Rabeya Khatun herself was examined as OPW-1, who in her deposition stated that:  নাঃ ভূমি ৩ কাঠা। উক্ত ভূমি আমি ইমান আলী হইতে এওয়াজ মূলে পাই। ইমানকে ১.৫০ কাঠা দেই। This witness in her cross-examination denied the suggestion that the deed in questions is out and out sale. OPW-2, Abu Taleb alias Amel Miah stated in his deposition that:  নাঃ জমি রাবেয়া খায়। সে ইমান আলীর সাথে বিনিময় করে। ইমানকে ১.৫০ কাঠা দেয়। নাঃ ৩ কাঠার চৌহদ্দির মধ্যে প্রার্থীদের জমি নাই। This witness in his cross-examination denied the suggestion that the deed in question is a sale deed. 

 13. From the above quoted evidence, it appears that OPW-1 and OPW-2 in their respective deposition categorically stated that the pre-emptee-opposite party No.1, got the case land by way of a exchange deed. The Court of appeal below as last Court of fact on consideration of the materials on record arrived at a finding that:  নালিশী দলিলটি তঞ্চকতা মতে বিনিময় দলিলহাবে সৃষ্টি করিয়াছে প্রকৃত পক্ষে নালিশী দলিলটি আদৌ বিনিময় দলিল নয় সাফ কবলা দলিল। ইহা সমর্থনে প্রার্থীপক্ষ প্রাসংগীক কোন সাক্ষ্য প্রমান আদালতে উপস্থাপন করে নাই এবং নালিশী দলিলটি একটি বিনিময় দলিল ইহা প্রার্থীপক্ষ প্রয়োজনীয় সমর্থন যুক্তি সাক্ষ্য দ্বারা প্রমান করে নাই। 

 15. Another aspect of the case must not be overlooked. In this ease none of the PWs testified that the pre-emptee-purchaser is a stranger to the case jute. In the pre-emption application, it has been stated that the pre-emptee-opposite party No.1 is a new purchaser ( নবাগত খরিদ্দার) though all the PWs. remain silent on this point at the time of making statement before the Court.
